Background (EN): Work-while-ill distress recedes, but physical warning signs may be overlooked.
背景注意（中）: 带病工作造成的痛苦减轻，但身体发出的警告信号也可能被忽略。
Context (EN): Illness and overwork are recognized earlier, supporting rest, medication, and help-seeking.
情境注意（中）: 更早识别疾病与过度工作，支持休息、服药和寻求帮助。
Focus (EN): Pain and work pressure remain highly active, reinforcing fear and resentment.
焦点注意（中）: 疼痛与工作压力仍然高度活跃，强化恐惧与怨恨。

Background (EN): The peaceful memory remains available, but work may continue to overshadow restorative moments.
背景注意（中）: 平静的记忆仍可被调取，但工作可能继续遮蔽恢复性的时刻。
Context (EN): The memory supports occasional pauses without abandoning responsibilities.
情境注意（中）: 这段记忆支持偶尔停下来，同时不必放弃责任。
Focus (EN): Restorative moments become an active part of daily life beyond work and productivity.
焦点注意（中）: 恢复性的时刻成为日常生活的主动组成部分，不再只围绕工作和生产力。

Background (EN): The achievement remains accessible, but external judgment may still dominate self-worth.
背景注意（中）: 成就仍可被想起，但外界评价仍可能主导自我价值。
Context (EN): Private achievement balances criticism without turning the hobby into another performance test.
情境注意（中）: 个人成就在不把爱好变成另一场表现考验的情况下，平衡外界批评。
Focus (EN): Patient creation becomes a stable source of satisfaction and self-worth.
焦点注意（中）: 耐心创造成为稳定的满足感与自我价值来源。

Background (EN): Parental disappointment loses influence, but the achievement may also feel less personally meaningful.
背景注意（中）: 父母的失望失去影响，但这项成就也可能变得不再具有个人意义。
Context (EN): Effort can be valued without needing first place to prove personal worth.
情境注意（中）: 无需用第一名证明个人价值，也可以认可自己的努力。
Focus (EN): Ranking and disappointment remain active, keeping achievement closely tied to self-worth.
焦点注意（中）: 排名与失望仍然活跃，使成就感继续紧密绑定自我价值。

Background (EN): Guilt about rest fades, but signs of exhaustion may also receive less attention.
背景注意（中）: 对休息的内疚减轻，但也可能较少关注疲惫的迹象。
Context (EN): Physical limits are recognized, and rest becomes part of responsible self-care.
情境注意（中）: 能够识别身体界限，休息成为负责任的自我照顾。
Focus (EN): Rest must still feel earned, turning self-care into another standard to perform correctly.
焦点注意（中）: 休息仍必须先被证明值得，使自我照顾变成另一项需要正确完成的标准。

Background (EN): Rejection has less control over help-seeking, making trusted support easier to approach.
背景注意（中）: 拒绝不再那么能控制求助行为，更容易接近值得信任的支持。
Context (EN): Support feels legitimate, though trust is chosen carefully and some hesitation remains.
情境注意（中）: 求助感到合理，但会谨慎选择信任对象，仍保留一些犹豫。
Focus (EN): Anticipated rejection encourages overexplaining, withdrawal, and carrying pressure alone.
焦点注意（中）: 预期中的拒绝促使过度解释、退缩，并独自承受压力。

Background (EN): Past humiliation no longer defines ability, though public criticism may still feel destabilizing.
背景注意（中）: 过去的羞辱不再定义能力，但公开批评仍可能造成动摇。
Context (EN): Mistakes can be reviewed and corrected without becoming proof of total incompetence.
情境注意（中）: 可以复盘和改正错误，而不把错误视为完全无能的证明。
Focus (EN): Mistakes and authority judgment remain highly active, encouraging perfectionism and repeated checking.
焦点注意（中）: 错误与权威评价仍高度活跃，促使完美主义和反复检查。
